transactions.description: Recalled LW Yegor Pinchuk from Milwaukee (AHL). Assigned G Matt Murray to Milwaukee.
Placed C Patrick Giles on waivers.
Acquired Fs Evan Rodrigues, Jesper Boqvist, and Ben Steeves from Florida in exchange for G Jacob Markstrom and F Angus Crookshank. Re-signed F Arseny Gritsyuk to a three-year contract.
Acquired two 2026 first-round picks (No. 15 and 29) from St. Louis Blues for F Mason McTavish.
Claimed D William Trudeau off waivers from New York.
Reinstated F Marc McLaughlin from long-term injured reserve and placed him on waivers.
Suspended D Logan Stanley for one game.
F Milan Lucic announced his retirement.
Fired head coach Patrick Roy. Hired Peter DeBoer as new head coach.
Reinstated Tomas Nosek from non-roster injured reserve.
Sent D Matt Kiersted to Iowa (AHL) and recalled G Cal Petersen from Iowa. Reinstated D Zach Bogosian from injured reserve.
Signed D Tristan Luneau to a six-year contract extension.
Reinstated G Semyon Varlamov from conditioning assignment with Bridgeport (AHL).
Assigned G Brandon Halverson to Syracuse (AHL). Recalled G Harrison Meneghin from Syracuse.
Sent D Alexander Alexeyev to Wilkes-Barre/Scranton (AHL). Recalled D Jack St. Ivany from Wilkes-Barre/Scranton. Reinstated C Evgeni Malkin from suspension.
Assigned F Andreas Johnsson to Utica (AHL). Activated c Nico Hischier from injured reserve.

Loaned G Nolan Lalonde, Fs Oiva Keskinen and Luke Tuch, and Ds Charlie Elick and Guillaume Richard to Cleveland (AHL). Designated Fs Mikael Pyyhtiä and Isac Lundestrom and G Elvis Merzlikins as injured non-roster. Waived for the purpose of assignment to Cleveland Ds Corson Ceulemans and Colton White. Placed D Dante Fabbro on injured reserve.

Recalled D Dennis Gilbert from Rochester (AHL). Placed G Alex Lyon and D Olen Zellweger on injured reserve. Signed D Louis Crevier to a four-year contract. Transferred F Matthew Savoie to long-term injured reserve.
